results.whySafeHeader: Why does this message appear safe?
results.safeDisclaimer: ⚠️ Note: A low-risk score does not guarantee absolute safety. Always verify sensitive financial requests directly with your bank.

reasons.SAFE_NO_SUSPICIOUS_URL: No suspicious or malicious URLs detected
reasons.SAFE_NO_CREDENTIAL_REQUEST: No request for sensitive passwords, OTP, or PIN
reasons.SAFE_NO_URGENT_LANGUAGE: No coercive or account-blocking threats detected
reasons.SAFE_INFORMATIONAL: Appears to be a standard informational or transactional message
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_URL: Contains suspicious or unverified web links
reasons.URGENCY: Urgent coercive language & account blocking threat (+15)
reasons.CREDENTIAL_REQS: Requests sensitive credentials (OTP, PIN, Password, Aadhaar) (+25)
reasons.ACTION_COERCION: Demands immediate link click or action (+15)
reasons.PERSONAL_SENDER_IMPERSONATION: Bank/Authority claim sent from personal mobile number (+15)

learn.title: Stay Safe — Awareness Guide
learn.subtitle: Learn to recognize common cyber fraud tactics in regional languages.
learn.emergencySubtitle: Immediate government hotline to report financial cyber fraud within 24 hours.
learn.card1Desc: Banks and financial institutions will NEVER ask for your OTP, ATM PIN, or UPI PIN via SMS or phone call.
learn.card2Desc: Do not click shortened links (bit.ly, tinyurl) or URLs ending in .xyz or .top sent from personal mobile numbers.
learn.card3Desc: Always verify official bank web domains (e.g. sbi.co.in, hdfcbank.com) before typing login credentials.
learn.card4Desc: Entering your UPI PIN subtracts money from your account. Never enter your PIN to RECEIVE money.
learn.card5Desc: Ignore messages claiming you won cash rewards or prizes requiring a processing fee or link click.
learn.card6Desc: Legitimate employers will never ask for registration fees or demand personal bank details through SMS.

emergency.step1: 1. Turn off Wi-Fi and Cellular Data immediately
emergency.step2: 2. Call bank customer care to freeze Net Banking & Cards
emergency.step3: 3. Change UPI PIN & Banking Passwords from a secure device
emergency.step4: 4. Report on Cybercrime Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) or call Helpline 1930

howItWorks.title: How It Works — Detection Engine Architecture
howItWorks.subtitle: Architecture overview of the 10-stage cybersecurity detection engine.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Accepts SMS text and sender header, cleaning payload limits and malformed JSON.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Removes hidden zero-width characters (\u200B) and normalizes lookalike homoglyphs.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Detects Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, English, or Code-Mixed text script ranges.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Inspects embedded links for HTTP, IP addresses, shorteners, suspicious TLDs, and brand mismatches.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Matches threat dictionaries for urgency, financial rewards, OTP/PIN requests, and impersonation.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Differentiates safe bank OTP alerts with safety warnings from coercive phishing threats.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Evaluates commercial 6-char headers vs 10-digit mobile number bank claims.
howItWorks.step8Desc: Classifies scam into KYC, Bank Fraud, OTP Scam, Lottery, or Informational categories.
howItWorks.step9Desc: Aggregates deduplicated signals into a 0-100 Risk Score and separate Confidence %.
howItWorks.step10Desc: Generates non-technical explanation bullet points in English, Telugu, Hindi, or Tamil.
